_about: Georg Curtius (1820-1885), Leipzig philologist, raw IA OCR of The Student's Greek Grammar (ed. William Smith, 4th ed. 1871) and its Elucidations, tr. Evelyn Abbott (1870); not Ernst Curtius the historian (ernst-curtius) or Quintus Curtius (curtius). Greek grammar and the study of the language (lane B, round eb: eighth IA subject sweep). No uids minted.

georg-curtius-students-greek-grammar-187: The Student's Greek Grammar: a grammar of the Greek language, by Dr. George Curtius, translated under the revision of the author, edited by William Smith, fourth edition (London: John Murray, 1871)
georg-curtius-elucidations-1870: Elucidations of the Student's Greek Grammar, by Prof. Curtius, from the German, with the author's sanction, by Evelyn Abbott (London: John Murray, 1870)
